description_en: Attaches tags to CloudConfig rules, account groups, and compliance packages
description_zh: 为配置审计的规则、账号组和合规包绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun config tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ACS::Config::Rule --resource-id cr-115b626622af00600000 --tag Value=prod Key=Env --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource in CloudConfig. Valid values:

`ACS::Config::Rule`: a rule for a single account.

`ACS::Config::AggregateConfigRule`: a rule for multiple accounts.

`ACS::Config::Aggregator`: an account group.

`ACS::Config::CompliancePack`: a compliance package for a single account.

`ACS::Config::AggregateCompliancePack`: a compliance package for multiple accounts
parameters.help_zh:
配置审计的资源类型。取值：
`ACS::Config::Rule`：单账号下的规则。
`ACS::Config::AggregateConfigRule`：多账号下的规则。
`ACS::Config::Aggregator`：账号组。
`ACS::Config::CompliancePack`：单账号下的合规包。
`ACS::Config::AggregateCompliancePack`：多账号下的合规包
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

You can attach a maximum of 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

最多支持绑定20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

You can attach a maximum of 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

最多支持绑定20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can attach a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag
